extensionDescription.message: Open WhatsApp conversation links in your existing WhatsApp Web tab, keeping the phone number and message.

activationFailed.message: Couldn't activate. Reload the extension and check its permissions for WhatsApp websites.

opening.message: Opening the conversation in WhatsApp Web…

opened.message: Conversation opened. You can close this tab.

errorInvalidLink.message: This link doesn't contain a valid conversation number or message.

errorRouting.message: Couldn't open the conversation. Your existing WhatsApp tab wasn't reloaded.

errorExtensionUnavailable.message: Couldn't reach the extension. Reload the extension and try again.
